ResearchProjectDef.label: plumbing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Lay water and sewage pipes and install unpowered fixtures such as rain barrels, water troughs and sewage outlets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: septic tanks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build septic tanks that hold sewage until it is treated or pumped out.

ResearchProjectDef.label: electric pumps
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build electric water pumps and pumping stations that push water through the plumbing network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: large water pumps
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build large pumping stations and huge water towers for colonies with heavy water demand.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep water wells
ResearchProjectDef.description: Drill deep wells that draw clean water from far below the surface.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fire suppression
ResearchProjectDef.description: Install sprinklers that extinguish fires with water from the plumbing network.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hygiene bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft and install bionic organs that reduce a colonist's need for the toilet and for washing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: asteroid cryo mining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extract water from ice-rich asteroids with cryo extraction nodes, which also give off heat.
